description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Single sofa along the lower portion of the plan facing the TV wall; dining table with four chairs set above the seating area near the kitchen. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, straight corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed not visible from front door, visible from kitchen. Fully open plan — cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area directly. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (single open studio with no separate bedrooms); roommates or flatshares (no private separated sleeping zones); people needing a home office (no desk or dedicated work area); those wanting bedroom privacy (open-plan bed visible from kitchen).
